title: Slow login
body: The login page takes forever to load and sometimes times out.

title: App crashes on startup
body: Every time I open the app it crashes within ten seconds please fix this.

title: Bad export
body: Exporting my data to CSV fails silently and I lose hours of work.

title: Confusing onboarding
body: The onboarding flow is impossible to understand I had to watch three tutorials.

title: Mobile layout broken
body: The mobile layout is completely broken half the screen is cut off.

title: No dark mode
body: Why is there no dark mode in 2025 this is unacceptable.

title: Slow search
body: Search takes 15 seconds to return results and I have a fast connection.

title: Bad notifications
body: The notification settings reset every time I log out extremely frustrating.

title: Pricing too high
body: Your pricing doubled overnight with no warning this is unacceptable.

title: Crashes on big files
body: The app crashes whenever I upload files larger than 50MB.
